script_text: The New Moon in Libra shifts focus to your home and heart this week, dear Cancer. Monday, your ruling Moon squares Saturn in your 10th House, making career decisions feel heavier than they are. Tuesday's Venus in Libra sextiles your natal Sun, so unexpected money flows easier than you expect for a Water sign. By Thursday, Mercury enters your 4th House, forcing you to speak truths you have avoided for months regarding your love life. The weekend brings Jupiter into your 8th House. This signals a financial recovery after a very long drought of income. Wednesday is your true power day because the New Moon conjuncts your 4th House. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars squares your sensitive Water Moon. Write down every single promise made in the bright light of this New Moon. Follow for daily updates and personalized insights every single morning.
